?Activate the panel now that Elly brought the keycard. Push the loose panel into the shredder to stop it. Carefully drop to the open door and continue. Try to open the door for a short scene, then continue through the door. In the soylent factory, head to this location to learn the shut off code. Input the shut off code in the code room (0101). Make your way to the other side of the conveyor belts and open the door. Continue on to the save point area and into the lab. In the conference room, the panel will unlock the security lock; go to second floor. The sound door code is Up, Down, Up, Left, Right. After the cutscene here, continue on with Fei in the dark.
